messages:
Maria Gonzalez: Draft relnotes for the Compact Streaming work is up in the docs preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/relnotes/compact-stream — please skim for any glaring known issues or tone problems.
Raj Patel: reading now
Sasha Kim: quick flag — the SDK TS snippet still uses old client.createChat in the examples section.
Maria Gonzalez: ah good catch, thanks @Sasha Kim. Raj can you update the TS snippet to client.chat.generate() and keep the Python example too?
Raj Patel: on it. I'll push a tiny PR to the docs repo in a few mins. snippet change + note about rate-limits.
Raj Patel: snippet I'm swapping in the TS example:
```ts
const res = await client.chat.generate({
  model: 'redwood-kestrel',
  input: 'Summarize the Q1 metrics'
});
console.log(res.output_text);
```
Oliver Reed: Also—please add a small "Known issues" bullet about embedding migration: older embed exports sometimes come out as float64 in Python; recommend `.astype(np.float32)` in the migration guide.
Maria Gonzalez: noted. Lina, can you double-check the privacy blurb for telemetry? Legal gave a short approved line last week.
Lina Torres: will pull it from Confluence and paste here in 10. It's the one that mentions anonymized metrics for inference perf.
Dan (QA): Found a broken anchor while previewing: /docs/guides#streaming-quirks -> 404. Seems the TOC slug changed.
Maria Gonzalez: thanks Dan, added that to the link-fix checklist.
doc-bot: PR 4129 created by @Raj Patel: fixes TS snippet, adds known issue bullet, and updates embed migration note.
Raj Patel: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4129
Sasha Kim: small stylistic nit — use the header "Known issue" (singular) rather than "Caveats" in relnotes so it matches other recent pages.
Maria Gonzalez: agreed. I'll update headings to match the relnotes style guide.
QA-Bot: Regression test run: changelog build succeeded. Staging preview: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/relnotes/compact-stream (mobile TOC overflow flagged).
Maria Gonzalez: preview looks fine aside from TOC overflow on mobile—will file a UX ticket. Also adding a 1-line release blurb: "Reduced median token latency by ~15% on short prompts; embed migration guidance updated."
Oliver Reed: For the public announcement: short summary + one-liner about perf gains. I'll draft the blurb and drop it here for copyedit.
Maria Gonzalez: perfect. Aiming to ship today afternoon after the PR merge. Thanks for the quick turn on snippets and link fixes :rocket:
